title: Expose, make uniform, and document optim functional APIs
body:
Key design decision:
- where to expose Adafactor and Muon's functional APIs? in torch.optim? or in torch.optim.adafactor.adafactor? This PR exposes them in top level `torch.optim` but then there is indeed an inconsistency with `torch.optim.adamw.adamw`.

This PR, in short, does:
- expose functional APIs (they already existed)
- document this more uniformly
- add big examples in optim.md for using them (and also step hooks), notably a bf16 adamw example. I think we can go without the step hooks example, but eh it doesn't save that much space.

Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
